reasoning: The code and the Kokkos mechanics are as described, but the resulting failure is a hard abort, not silent zeroing. allocate_kokkos (dihedral_fourier_kokkos.cpp:345-370) calls k_k.resize(n+1,nterms_max) etc. on plain Kokkos DualViews (DAT::tdual_kkfloat_2d expands to Kokkos::DualView via KOKKOS_DEVICE_DUALVIEW, kokkos_type.h:1177-1178, 1238). With no execution-space property, Kokkos_DualView.hpp:1027-1031 chooses 'if (modified_flags(1) >= modified_flags(0)) resize_on_device(...)'; resize_on_device (:962-973) resizes only d_view and then resync_host (:1040-1048) does 'h_view = create_mirror_view(typename t_host::memory_space(), d_view);' -- a fresh value-initialized host array, NOT a copy -- and marks the device modified. compute() ends with 'k_k.template sync<DeviceType>();' (:96-100), and sync resets BOTH flags to 0 (Kokkos_DualView.hpp:524-525), so a dihedral_coeff issued after a run that grows nterms_max (dihedral_fourier.cpp:298 'nterms_max = MAX(nterms_max,nterms_one);') does take the device branch and does wipe the host mirror. WHAT HAPPENS NEXT is the correction: coeff() then calls k_k.modify_host() (:397-401) while modified_flags(1) is already 1, and Kokkos::DualView::modify_host (Kokkos_DualView.hpp:780-799) aborts with 'Kokkos::DualView::modify_host ERROR: Concurrent modification of host and device views'. So on a GPU build the input aborts loudly rather than silently producing zero coefficients. Host-only builds are unaffected: the DualView is then single-device, modify_* are no-ops and create_mirror_view returns the same view. Before the first run the flags make resize take the host branch, which is correct, so only a coeff-after-run that changes the dimensions is affected. dihedral_nharmonic_kokkos.cpp:341-357 has the identical allocate_kokkos shape and needs the same fix.
fix: In allocate_kokkos(), make the host copy authoritative before resizing: for each dual view call 'k_x.sync_host(); k_x.modify_host();' immediately before 'k_x.resize(...)' (this forces Kokkos' resize_on_host branch, which preserves the host contents and rebuilds the device mirror). Apply the same change to DihedralNHarmonicKokkos::allocate_kokkos.
